user_visible_outcome: An active admin can replace one photograph in a content draft without changing its position or cover meaning, while the currently published family version stays unchanged.
user_journeys: Sujith or Paru uploads or selects a replacement photograph and replaces the chosen draft photograph.
The admin sees a truthful success or failure result and the refreshed draft state.
Family viewers continue seeing the existing published revision until an explicit republish.
non_negotiable_quality: Only active Pawpaw admins may replace draft photographs.
The database swap of association, position, and draft cover is atomic.
Failure leaves the old draft association usable and the published revision unchanged.
The old media record and Storage object are retained in the Media Library; this task performs no deletion.
No private family photograph is used in automated verification.
realistic_harms_prevented: A failed replacement must not leave a missing photograph or broken cover.
A stale admin page must not silently replace the wrong association.
Draft changes must not leak into the published family view.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Either active admin can replace an existing draft media association with an eligible replacement.
The replacement preserves the old display position and transfers draft cover only when the old photograph was the draft cover.
Invalid, stale, same-media, unauthorized, or cross-content requests fail with no partial relational change.
Published revision content and revision-media snapshots remain unchanged until explicit republish.
The server action uploads or confirms the replacement first, calls one atomic RPC, never deletes old media, and reports failure truthfully.
Type-check, lint, full tests, and production build pass after implementation.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: npm.cmd run type-check && npm.cmd run lint && npm.cmd test && npm.cmd run build

non_goals: Delete old media records or Storage objects.
Automatic cleanup, cleanup queues, retry jobs, cron, workers, or generic job infrastructure.
Change immutable published revisions, publication semantics, chronology, authorship, authentication architecture, or viewer routes.
Add dependencies, services, framework upgrades, video, PWA, notifications, deployment, or remote Supabase changes.
Build for hundreds of concurrent editors or hostile trusted administrators.
simplest_acceptable_approach: Create one forward-only migration containing one active-admin-authorized PostgreSQL RPC that locks and atomically swaps the draft association, order, and draft cover. Call it from the existing admin action after the replacement upload/media record exists. Keep the old media untouched in the Media Library. Add focused database and application tests, then run the existing full verification.
